violations.text: An employee was observed touching ready to eat food (chives) with bare hands. Food employees must not touch exposed, ready-to-eat food with their bare hands and shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, single use gloves, or dispensing equipment. Food items were voluntarily disposed of during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/14/2026

Working containers (spray bottles) used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Spray bottles were labeled during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/14/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the 3-door low boy unit. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/14/2026
